name: Nonna — Back Office
description: The trattoria's back office: the rota, sick calls and cover, purchase orders waiting for a signature, and the invoice ledger — rendered as Nonna's living desk inside Copilot.

conversation_starters.title: A sick call
conversation_starters.text: Maria called in sick for tonight — show me the rota and who could cover.

conversation_starters.title: Waiting for a signature
conversation_starters.text: Which purchase orders need my approval?

conversation_starters.title: The books
conversation_starters.text: Show me the latest supplier invoices.
